items.quote: Do yourself a favor next time you need plumbing work: call Florida Plumb Pros. Luis Molina, the plumber tech who came to my home, was very polite, knew exactly what he needed to do, and answered my questions clearly. Before starting, he carefully prepared the work area to protect my home. He even cleaned up when he was finished.

Luis Molina was excellent! I highly recommend their services. He was very professional and did the job very efficiently and quickly. He also helped me test for potential water pressure issues as a courtesy. I will be going back to them for all of my plumbing needs.

When my water heater unexpectedly stopped working, Luis quickly stepped in, purchased a new water heater, and had it installed the very same day. Luis was professional, respectful, and worked efficiently to complete the job much faster than I expected.
